notes.title: Mistified - Official Full Release!
notes.content:
As a small indie studio developing their debut game, we've worked hard over the past few years trying to create a puzzle game that we could be proud of, and as of today, we are thrilled to announce that the full Steam release of Mistified is finally here!

This milestone is something we don't take lightly; you only get to release your first game once, and it wouldn’t have been possible without each and every one of our players from the demo to the early access build. Your feedback, suggestions, and support helped 
shape Mistified into the game it is today. Whether you’ve been with us since day one or are joining us now, we can’t wait for you to experience Mistified in its full glory. 

Thank you for making this dream a reality. We’ll see you in the mist!

Happy Puzzling!
-Spicebound Studios



With the full release, we’ve packed in a major update that will transform your adventure into an even more immersive, visually stunning, and smoothly fun experience.

Patch notes are as follows:

Visuals Reimagined:
- Overhaul of the pitfall design
- Reworked artwork with new dynamic animations 
- Revamped spawning effects 
- Fresh decorative elements that add aesthetic touches to the surroundings
- Enhanced Secondary Animations

River Visuals:
- Our rivers have had a complete makeover.
- Navigate with style, as ghost waves now clearly show which way the water flows.

Puzzles:
- We’ve injected a fresh batch of puzzles. Every new challenge is designed to test your wit!
- Fixed "issues" caused by players being too good at puzzles and finding unintended solutions.
- Fixed minor bugs like our quirky bull’s misadventures that once had logs rolling in odd ways.

Performance:
- Optimised Loading Times so you can jump into the action faster, no more waiting around!
- Smarter Mist particles let you enjoy a cleaner, crisper visual experience.

Meta:
- Revamped Loading Screen
- Controller compatibility
- Full Steam Deck functionality
- Mac users can now join in on the fun too, as we now have full Mac support.

[previewyoutube=EsUxHkWifPM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Community Feedback Update - November 30th
notes.content:
A few minor bug fixes and visual updates based on initial community feedback!

- Fixed a bug where you could get out of a puzzle and roam the wilderness.
- Fixed a bug causing the game to fail to load in VERY specific circumstances.

- Added fresh visuals to the Lantern Lights to highlight how many trees can be chopped down a little easier.
- Added some additional visuals to the Loading screen.

Thank you for all the feedback so far, join our Discord to be part of the community and help shape the game!
https://discord.gg/s9P2ztkpsT

notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.content:
The new update adds the following:

- Save system
- New and updated animations and visuals
- General bug fixes
- Changes and tweaks, reflecting feedback and suggestions from everyone here.
- Slight rearrangement of the previous demo area.

notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.content:
The new update adds the following:

[list]
[*] Open world environment
[*] Puzzle based travel system
[*] 5+ new sets of puzzles, more than tripling the size of the demo
[*] New animals and traps to spice up the puzzles
[*] New animations and visuals
[*] Lost souls to find
[*] General bug fixes
[*] Changes and tweaks, reflecting feedback and suggestions from everyone here.
[*] Slight rearrangement of the previous demo area.
[*] A weekly puzzle has been added.
[/list] A unique weekly puzzle can be found through the button on the in-game menu. This puzzle will refresh every Friday, and the first one is up now. Will you be the first to solve it?
